editorial_control_prompt: Write 6 stories in play that move markets most, each with named actors, explicit contradiction, transmission channel, and 24h action playbook.

cards.title: Middle East Risk Premium Re-enters Crude
cards.summary: US-Iran strikes have reintroduced a live geopolitical premium into oil and maritime insurance.
cards.body: If corridor risk persists in Hormuz, inflation expectations stay firmer, transport margins compress, and near-term easing odds remain vulnerable.
cards.contradiction: Diplomatic signaling says de-escalation while shipping risk pricing says escalation is still the base case.
cards.transmission: Oil + freight insurance -> inflation breakevens -> rates path repricing -> equity duration compression.

playbook.entry: Add energy-upside and inflation-sensitive hedges on confirmed risk-premium extension.
playbook.invalidation: Sustained de-escalation plus falling freight premia and lower Brent term structure stress.
playbook.next_24h: Track Strait-of-Hormuz headlines, insurer commentary, and front-month Brent reaction.

cards.title: Policy Path Still Inflation-Constrained
cards.summary: Fed communication remains inflation-first, keeping the cut path conditional rather than scheduled.
cards.body: Practical effect: support for real yields and USD, with downside pressure concentrated in duration-sensitive equities and rate-dependent financing channels.
cards.contradiction: Market messaging hunts for cuts while policy language still prioritizes inflation credibility.
cards.transmission: Hawkish hold -> higher real yields + stronger USD -> tighter global conditions -> pressure on growth multiples.

playbook.entry: Lean into quality cash-flow and short-duration exposure while cut-pricing remains overextended.
playbook.invalidation: Clear downside inflation surprise paired with explicit Fed guidance toward accelerated easing.
playbook.next_24h: Watch front-end yield moves, DXY reaction, and Fed speaker dispersion.

cards.title: AI Leadership Remains Concentrated
cards.summary: AI capex visibility continues directing equity flows into a narrow semiconductor-hyperscaler cluster.
cards.body: Concentrated positioning is now the core fragility variable, because modest guidance misses can propagate quickly into breadth deterioration and volatility repricing.
cards.contradiction: Everyone says diversification while portfolio behavior keeps adding to the same crowded AI leaders.
cards.transmission: Guidance miss -> leadership drawdown -> index breadth deterioration -> vol expansion and de-grossing.

playbook.entry: Keep exposure but pair with concentration hedges and breadth/volatility protection.
playbook.invalidation: Broad earnings strength across non-mega-cap sectors with durable breadth improvement.
playbook.next_24h: Watch leadership internals, implied vol skew, and post-earnings guidance reactions.

cards.title: China EV Momentum Faces Policy Friction
cards.summary: China EV export acceleration is colliding with US and EU market-access defenses.
cards.body: Sector pricing now depends as much on tariff sequence and industrial policy timing as on underlying demand, especially across autos, batteries, and metals.
cards.contradiction: Consumers seek cheaper EVs while policymakers prioritize domestic strategic capacity and jobs.
cards.transmission: Tariff escalation -> margin pressure + supply-chain rerouting -> autos/batteries/metal repricing.

playbook.entry: Prefer policy-resilient suppliers and avoid unhedged cross-border margin exposure.
playbook.invalidation: Trade détente with postponed tariffs and coordinated market-access carve-outs.
playbook.next_24h: Monitor tariff commentary, OEM guidance revisions, and battery-material spread moves.

cards.title: LNG Contracts Signal Bloc Formation
cards.summary: Long-horizon LNG contracts continue functioning as geopolitical insurance and industrial cost hedges.
cards.body: Capital allocation indicates that energy-security priorities remain structurally dominant, even while official narratives continue emphasizing accelerated decarbonization pathways.
cards.contradiction: Public transition language remains aggressive while long-dated fossil security contracts keep expanding.
cards.transmission: Security contracting -> infrastructure capex persistence -> utilities/industrial input repricing.

playbook.entry: Favor infrastructure and utility names with secure long-term procurement visibility.
playbook.invalidation: Material demand destruction plus visible policy-induced acceleration away from gas contracts.
playbook.next_24h: Watch contract announcements, energy-ministry signals, and regional gas basis behavior.

cards.title: Event Markets Reprice Compliance Risk
cards.summary: Insider-information allegations raise the probability of tighter enforcement and higher compliance burdens for event-market platforms.
cards.body: Valuation should increasingly depend on market-integrity controls, while weaker operators face faster trust and liquidity deterioration.
cards.contradiction: Product growth optics are strong but legal and integrity risk premia are climbing underneath.
cards.transmission: Enforcement cycle -> higher compliance cost + lower trust -> thinner liquidity -> valuation compression.

playbook.entry: Differentiate operators by compliance architecture and transparent surveillance controls.
playbook.invalidation: Regulatory clarity with permissive framework and declining legal-event frequency.
playbook.next_24h: Track enforcement headlines, platform policy updates, and liquidity-depth metrics.
